def admissible(receipt, batch, output):
    return receipt.get("status") == "completed" and receipt.get("offered_concurrency") == batch

<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Crocodile Bike</title></head>
<body>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="360" height="220" viewBox="0 0 360 220">
  <g id="crocodile">
    <path d="M120 80 Q170 55 220 80 L250 90 L220 100 Q170 120 120 100 Z" fill="#4a8f3c"/>
    <circle id="wheel-back" cx="110" cy="160" r="34" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 110 160" to="360 110 160" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle id="wheel-front" cx="250" cy="160" r="34" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 250 160" to="360 250 160" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <path d="M110 160 L180 160 L250 160" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M110 160 L150 110 L250 160" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M150 110 L180 160" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/>
    <g id="legs">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.7;1;0.7" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M170 100 L160 140" stroke="#2f6b26" stroke-width="6"/>
      <path d="M195 100 L205 140" stroke="#2f6b26" stroke-width="6"/>
    </g>
    <g id="body">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-2 180 80;2 180 80;-2 180 80" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M120 80 Q170 55 220 80" stroke="#4a8f3c" stroke-width="12" fill="none"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
</body></html>
